title: L-bracket
prompt:
All dimensions are millimetres. Build exactly what is described — no fillets, chamfers, draft or extra features unless the description asks for them. Leave the finished part in the document; do not export anything.

An L-shaped bracket, one solid piece:
- a base 80 along X, 60 along Y, 6 thick along Z, corner at the origin,
  extending into +X, +Y, +Z;
- an upright wall 6 thick that rises from the base to a total height of 50 in
  Z, occupying X from 0 to 6 and the full 60 of Y.
The two meet in a square inside corner (no fillet).

checks.why: the legs are fused, not two bodies
an L profile has fourteen planar faces; a block has six
